releaseNotes:
- UI modernization and navigation improvements, and many more...

Team Netra

changelog.text: Added 4x, 8x, and 16x scan speeds with swipe gestures and auto-mute.
Improved cross-platform sidebar navigation and stepped remote controls.
Moved M3U and XMLTV parsing to background isolates for smoother UI.
Redesigned IPTV channel drawer with frosted glass and better focus states.
Preserved HTTP headers during channel switching and locked playback to live.
Added disguised HLS segment detection and MPEG-TS sync-byte detection on desktop.
Removed torrent streaming and libtorrent dependencies.
